2:  * vendor/artinchip/chips/d13x/artinchip_fb.c
3:  ****************************************************************************/

5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
7: #include <nuttx/cache.h>
8: #include <nuttx/kmalloc.h>
9: #include <nuttx/video/fb.h>
10: 
11: #include <errno.h>
12: #include <stdbool.h>
13: #include <stdint.h>
14: #include <string.h>
15: 
16: #include "artinchip_de.h"
17: #include "artinchip_lvds.h"
18: #include "artinchip_panel.h"
19: 
20: #define D13X_FB_WIDTH          1024u
21: #define D13X_FB_HEIGHT         600u
22: #define D13X_FB_BPP            16u
23: #define D13X_FB_STRIDE         (D13X_FB_WIDTH * 2u)
24: #define D13X_FB_FRAME_SIZE     (D13X_FB_STRIDE * D13X_FB_HEIGHT)
25: #define D13X_FB_BUFFERS        2u
26: #define D13X_FB_TOTAL_SIZE     (D13X_FB_FRAME_SIZE * D13X_FB_BUFFERS)
27: #define D13X_CACHE_LINE_SIZE   32u
28: #define D13X_CACHE_RANGE_LIMIT (64u * 1024u)
29: #define THEAD_MHCR_DCACHE_EN   (1u << 1)
30: 
31: struct d13x_fb_state_s
32: {
33:   bool initialized;
34:   bool power_on;
35:   uint8_t *memory;
36:   uint32_t displayed_yoffset;
37:   struct fb_area_s update_area;
38:   bool update_pending;
39: };
40: 
41: static struct d13x_fb_state_s g_fb;
42: 
43: static void d13x_fb_clean_cache(void)
44: {
45:   uint32_t mhcr;
46: 
47:   /* The custom D13x port does not expose NuttX ARCH_DCACHE hooks, while the
48:    * E907 may inherit an enabled write-back cache from the bootloader.  Use
49:    * the vendor's numeric CSR and raw dcache.call encoding so ordinary GCC
50:    * toolchains still make framebuffer writes visible to the DE DMA master.
51:    */
52: 
53:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrr %0, 0x7c1" : "=r"(mhcr));
54:   if ((mhcr & THEAD_MHCR_DCACHE_EN) != 0)
55:     {
56:       __asm__ __volatile__("fence rw, rw" ::: "memory");
57:       __asm__ __volatile__(".long 0x0010000b" ::: "memory");
58:       __asm__ __volatile__("fence rw, rw" ::: "memory");
59:     }
60: }
61: 
62: static void d13x_fb_clean_cache_area(const void *address, size_t row_bytes,
63:                                      size_t stride, size_t row_count)
64: {
65:   uintptr_t row;
66:   uint32_t mhcr;
67:   size_t index;
68: 
69:   if (row_bytes == 0 || row_count == 0)
70:     {
71:       return;
72:     }
73: 
74:   /* A cache-wide clean is bounded by the cache capacity and is faster than
75:    * issuing tens of thousands of per-line operations for a large redraw.
76:    */
77: 
78:   if (row_bytes * row_count >= D13X_CACHE_RANGE_LIMIT)
79:     {
80:       d13x_fb_clean_cache();
81:       return;
82:     }
83: 
84:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrr %0, 0x7c1" : "=r"(mhcr));
85:   if ((mhcr & THEAD_MHCR_DCACHE_EN) == 0)
86:     {
87:       return;
88:     }
89: 
90:   __asm__ __volatile__("fence" ::: "memory");
91:   row = (uintptr_t)address;
92:   for (index = 0; index < row_count; index++)
93:     {
94:       uintptr_t current = row & ~(D13X_CACHE_LINE_SIZE - 1u);
95:       uintptr_t end = (row + row_bytes + D13X_CACHE_LINE_SIZE - 1u) &
96:                       ~(D13X_CACHE_LINE_SIZE - 1u);
97: 
98:       while (current < end)
99:         {
100:           register uintptr_t cache_address __asm__("a0") = current;
101: 
102:           /* T-Head dcache.cpa cleans one physical cache line. */
103: 
104:           __asm__ __volatile__(".long 0x0295000b" : "+r"(cache_address) ::
105:                                "memory");
106:           current += D13X_CACHE_LINE_SIZE;
107:         }
108: 
109:       row += stride;
110:     }
111: 
112:   __asm__ __volatile__("fence\n\t"
113:                        "fence.i\n\t"
114:                        ".long 0x01a0000b" ::: "memory");
115: }

129:   vinfo->yres = D13X_FB_HEIGHT;

140:     {
141:       return -EINVAL;
142:     }

145:   pinfo->fblen = D13X_FB_TOTAL_SIZE;
146:   pinfo->stride = D13X_FB_STRIDE;
147:   pinfo->display = 0;
148:   pinfo->bpp = D13X_FB_BPP;
149:   pinfo->xres_virtual = D13X_FB_WIDTH;
150:   pinfo->yres_virtual = D13X_FB_HEIGHT * D13X_FB_BUFFERS;
151:   pinfo->xoffset = 0;
152:   pinfo->yoffset = 0;

156: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_UPDATE
157: static int d13x_fb_updatearea(struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
158:                               const struct fb_area_s *area)
159: {
160:   uint32_t x;
161:   uint32_t y;
162:   uint32_t width;
163:   uint32_t height;
164:   uintptr_t address;
165: 
166:   (void)vtable;
167: 
168:   if (area == NULL || !g_fb.initialized || area->w == 0 || area->h == 0)
169:     {
170:       return -EINVAL;
171:     }
172: 
173:   x = area->x;
174:   y = area->y;
175:   width = area->w;
176:   height = area->h;
177:   if (x >= D13X_FB_WIDTH || y >= D13X_FB_HEIGHT * D13X_FB_BUFFERS)
178:     {
179:       return -EINVAL;
180:     }
181: 
182:   if (width > D13X_FB_WIDTH - x)
183:     {
184:       width = D13X_FB_WIDTH - x;
185:     }
186: 
187:   if (height > D13X_FB_HEIGHT * D13X_FB_BUFFERS - y)
188:     {
189:       height = D13X_FB_HEIGHT * D13X_FB_BUFFERS - y;
190:     }
191: 
192:   address = (uintptr_t)g_fb.memory + y * D13X_FB_STRIDE + x * 2u;
193: 
194:   d13x_fb_clean_cache_area((const void *)address, width * 2u,
195:                            D13X_FB_STRIDE, height);
196:   g_fb.update_area.x = x;
197:   g_fb.update_area.y = y % D13X_FB_HEIGHT;
198:   g_fb.update_area.w = width;
199:   g_fb.update_area.h = height;
200:   g_fb.update_pending = true;
201:   return OK;
202: }
203: #endif

205: static int d13x_fb_pandisplay(struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
206:                               struct fb_planeinfo_s *pinfo)
207: {
208:   uintptr_t address;
209: 
210:   (void)vtable;
211: 
212:   if (pinfo == NULL || !g_fb.initialized ||
213:       (pinfo->yoffset != 0 && pinfo->yoffset != D13X_FB_HEIGHT))
214:     {
215:       return -EINVAL;
216:     }
217: 
218:   address = (uintptr_t)g_fb.memory + pinfo->yoffset * D13X_FB_STRIDE;
219: 
220:   /* LVGL uses DIRECT double buffering.  Before drawing a new dirty area it
221:    * copies the previous frame's dirty areas into the back buffer so both
222:    * framebuffers remain identical.  FBIO_UPDATE only describes the current
223:    * dirty area and therefore does not cover those synchronization copies.
224:    * Cleaning just that area can leave stale cache lines in the back buffer,
225:    * which appear as old labels and widgets after the subsequent page flip.
226:    *
227:    * Clean the complete (finite) data cache immediately before publishing the
228:    * buffer.  This makes every LVGL write visible to the DE DMA master.  It is
229:    * also cheaper than walking the entire 1.2 MiB framebuffer line by line.
230:    */
231: 
232:   d13x_fb_clean_cache();
233:   d13x_de_set_framebuffer(address);
234:   g_fb.displayed_yoffset = pinfo->yoffset;
235:   return OK;
236: }

238: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_SYNC
239: static int d13x_fb_waitforvsync(struct fb_vtable_s *vtable)
240: {
241:   uint32_t source_y;
242:   uint32_t dest_y;
243:   uint32_t row;
244:   int ret;
245: 
246:   ret = d13x_de_wait_for_vsync();
247: 
248:   if (g_fb.update_pending)
249:     {
250:       source_y = g_fb.displayed_yoffset + g_fb.update_area.y;
251:       dest_y = (g_fb.displayed_yoffset == 0 ? D13X_FB_HEIGHT : 0) +
252:                g_fb.update_area.y;
253: 
254:       /* LVGL rendered the merged dirty area into the newly displayed page.
255:        * Mirror that exact area after the frame boundary so the next DIRECT
256:        * buffer starts from identical pixels instead of an older UI state.
257:        */
258: 
259:       for (row = 0; row < g_fb.update_area.h; row++)
260:         {
261:           memcpy(g_fb.memory + (dest_y + row) * D13X_FB_STRIDE +

130: #endif

132:   de_write(TIMING_ACTIVE_SIZE, de_size(width, height));
133:   de_write(TIMING_H_PORCH, ((hbp & 0x1fffu) << 16) |
134:                             (hfp & 0x1fffu));
135:   de_write(TIMING_V_PORCH, ((vbp & 0x1fffu) << 16) |
136:                             (vfp & 0x1fffu));
137:   de_write(TIMING_SYNC_PULSE, ((vsync & 0x7ffu) << 16) |
138:                                (hsync & 0x7ffu));
139:   de_write(TIMING_POLARITY, 0);
140:   de_write(TIMING_LINE_SET, 2u << 16);
141: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_SYNC

145: #endif

150:   de_write(UI_LAYER_OFFSET, 0);

440: int aicfb_ioctl(int cmd, void *args) {
441:   struct aicfb_ioctl_cmd *ioctl = aicfb_ioctl_cmds;
442:   struct aicfb_info *fbi = aicfb_get_drvdata();
443: 
444:   /* Handle standard NuttX FBIOPAN_DISPLAY command */
445:   if (cmd == FBIOPAN_DISPLAY) {
446:     struct fb_planeinfo_s *pinfo = (struct fb_planeinfo_s *)args;
447:     return aicfb_pan_display(fbi, pinfo->yoffset / fbi->height);
448:   }
449: 
450:   do {
451:     if ((ioctl->cmd == cmd) && ioctl->f)
452:       return ioctl->f(fbi, args);
453: 
454:     ioctl++;
455:   } while (ioctl->cmd != 0xFFFF);
456: 
457:   pr_err("Invalid ioctl cmd %#x\n", cmd);
458:   return -EINVAL;
459: }

505: #ifdef AIC_FB_ROTATE_EN
506:   draw_buf_num = AIC_FB_DRAW_BUF_NUM;

514: int aicfb_probe(void) {
515:   struct aicfb_info *fbi;
516: #ifndef AIC_MPP_VIN_DEV
517:   size_t fb_size = 0;
518: #endif
519:   int ret = -EINVAL;
520: 
521:   if (aicfb_probed) {
522:     return 0;
523:   }
524: 
525:   fbi = (struct aicfb_info *)kmm_zalloc(sizeof(*fbi));
526:   if (!fbi) {
527:     pr_err("alloc fb_info failed\n");
528:     return -ENOMEM;
529:   }
530:   memset(fbi, 0x0, sizeof(*fbi));
531: 
532:   fbi->de = aicfb_find_component(drivers, AIC_DE_COM, ARRAY_SIZE(drivers));
533:   if (!fbi->de) {
534:     pr_err("failed to find de component\n");
535:     goto err;
536:   }
537: 
538:   fbi->di = aicfb_find_component(drivers, AIC_DI_TYPE, ARRAY_SIZE(drivers));
539:   if (!fbi->di) {
540:     pr_err("failed to find di component\n");
541:     goto err;
542:   }
543: 
544:   fbi->panel = aic_find_panel(AIC_DI_TYPE);
545:   if (!fbi->panel) {
546:     pr_err("failed to find panel component\n");
547:     goto err;
548:   }
549: 
550:   aicfb_get_panel_info(fbi);
551: 
552:   aicfb_fb_info_setup(fbi);
553: 
554:   aicfb_register_panel_callback(fbi);
555: 
556: #ifndef AIC_MPP_VIN_DEV
557:   fb_size = aicfb_calc_fb_size(fbi);
558:   /* fb_start must be cache line align */
559:   fbi->fb_start = (void *)kmm_memalign(CACHE_LINE_SIZE, fb_size);
560:   if (!fbi->fb_start) {
561:     ret = -ENOMEM;
562:     pr_err("alloc frame buffer failed\n");
563:     goto err;
564:   }
565:   pr_info("fb0 allocated at 0x%x\n", (u32)(uintptr_t)fbi->fb_start);
566: 
567:   fb_color_block(fbi, fb_size);
568: #endif
569: 
570:   aicfb_probed = true;
571:   fbi->power_on = false;
572:   aicfb_set_drvdata(fbi);
573: 
574:   aicfb_enable_clk(fbi, AICFB_ON);
575: 
576:   aicfb_update_alpha(fbi);
577: 
578:   aicfb_update_layer(fbi);
579: 
580:   /* Always enable panel and set power on */
581:   fbi->power_on = true;
582:   aicfb_enable_panel(fbi, AICFB_ON);
583: 
584:   /* LCD device registration removed - using only /dev/fb0 */
585: 
586:   return 0;
587: 
588: err:
589:   kmm_free(fbi);
590:   fbi = NULL;
591:   return ret;
592: }

47:   struct aic_lcd_dev_s *priv = (struct aic_lcd_dev_s *)dev;
48: 
49:   if (!priv || !vinfo || !priv->fbi)
50:     return -EINVAL;
51: 
52:   vinfo->xres = priv->fbi->width;
53:   vinfo->yres = priv->fbi->height;
54:   vinfo->nplanes = 1;
55:   vinfo->fmt = FB_FMT_RGB32;
56: 
57:   return OK;
58: }
59: 
60: static int aic_lcd_getplaneinfo(FAR struct lcd_dev_s *dev, unsigned int planeno,
61:                                 FAR struct lcd_planeinfo_s *pinfo) {
62:   struct aic_lcd_dev_s *priv = (struct aic_lcd_dev_s *)dev;
63: 
64:   if (!priv || !pinfo || planeno != 0)
65:     return -EINVAL;
66: 
67:   if (!priv->fbi)
68:     return -EINVAL;
69: 
70:   pinfo->putrun = NULL;
71:   pinfo->getrun = NULL;
72:   pinfo->buffer = NULL;
73:   pinfo->bpp = 32;
74:   pinfo->dev = dev;
75: 
76:   return OK;
77: }
78: 
79: static int aic_lcd_getpower(struct lcd_dev_s *dev) { return LCD_FULL_ON; }
80: 
81: static int aic_lcd_setpower(struct lcd_dev_s *dev, int power) {
82:   if (power > 0)
83:     aicfb_ioctl(AICFB_POWERON, NULL);
84:   else
85:     aicfb_ioctl(AICFB_POWEROFF, NULL);
86: 
87:   return OK;
88: }
89: 
90: static int aic_lcd_getcontrast(struct lcd_dev_s *dev) { return 0; }
91: 
92: static int aic_lcd_setcontrast(struct lcd_dev_s *dev, unsigned int contrast) {
93:   return -ENOSYS;
94: }
95: 
96: static int aic_lcd_setframerate(struct lcd_dev_s *dev, int rate) {
97:   return -ENOSYS;
98: }
99: 
100: static int aic_lcd_getframerate(struct lcd_dev_s *dev) { return 60; }
101: 
102: static int aic_lcd_open(FAR struct lcd_dev_s *dev) {
103:   struct aic_lcd_dev_s *priv = (struct aic_lcd_dev_s *)dev;
104: 
105:   nxsem_wait(&priv->sem);
106:   pr_debug("LCD device opened\n");
107:   nxsem_post(&priv->sem);
108: 
109:   return OK;
110: }
111: 
112: static int aic_lcd_close(FAR struct lcd_dev_s *dev) {
113:   struct aic_lcd_dev_s *priv = (struct aic_lcd_dev_s *)dev;
114: 
115:   nxsem_wait(&priv->sem);
116:   pr_debug("LCD device closed\n");
117:   nxsem_post(&priv->sem);
118: 
119:   return OK;
120: }
121: 
122: static void aic_lcd_initdev(struct aic_lcd_dev_s *priv) {
123:   priv->fbi = aicfb_get_drvdata();
124:   if (!priv->fbi) {
125:     pr_err("Failed to get framebuffer info\n");
126:     return;
127:   }
128: 
129:   priv->dev.getvideoinfo = aic_lcd_getvideoinfo;
130:   priv->dev.getplaneinfo = aic_lcd_getplaneinfo;
131:   priv->dev.getpower = aic_lcd_getpower;
132:   priv->dev.setpower = aic_lcd_setpower;
133:   priv->dev.getcontrast = aic_lcd_getcontrast;
134:   priv->dev.setcontrast = aic_lcd_setcontrast;
135:   priv->dev.setframerate = aic_lcd_setframerate;
136:   priv->dev.getframerate = aic_lcd_getframerate;
137:   priv->dev.open = aic_lcd_open;
138:   priv->dev.close = aic_lcd_close;
139:   priv->dev.ioctl = NULL;
140: 
141:   nxsem_init(&priv->sem, 0, 1);
142: }
143: 
144: /* LCD ioctl commands */
145: #define LCDIOC_POWERON _LCDIOC(1)
146: #define LCDIOC_POWEROFF _LCDIOC(2)
147: #define LCDIOC_GETINFO _LCDIOC(3)
148: #define LCDIOC_SETBRIGHTNESS _LCDIOC(4)
149: 
150: struct lcd_info_s {
151:   uint32_t width;
152:   uint32_t height;
153:   uint32_t bpp;
154:   uint32_t fmt;
155: };
156: 
157: static int lcd_open(FAR struct file *filep) {
158:   struct aic_lcd_dev_s *priv = &g_lcddev;
159: 
160:   nxsem_wait(&priv->sem);
161: 
162:   pr_debug("LCD device opened\n");
163: 
164:   nxsem_post(&priv->sem);
165:   return OK;
166: }
167: 
168: static int lcd_close(FAR struct file *filep) {
169:   struct aic_lcd_dev_s *priv = &g_lcddev;
170: 
171:   nxsem_wait(&priv->sem);
172: 
173:   pr_debug("LCD device closed\n");
174: 
175:   nxsem_post(&priv->sem);
176:   return OK;
177: }
178: 
179: static ssize_t lcd_read(FAR struct file *filep, FAR char *buffer,
180:                         size_t buflen) {
181:   return -ENOSYS;
182: }
183: 
184: static ssize_t lcd_write(FAR struct file *filep, FAR const char *buffer,
185:                          size_t buflen) {
186:   return -ENOSYS;
187: }
188: 
189: static int lcd_ioctl(FAR struct file *filep, int cmd, unsigned long arg) {
190:   struct aic_lcd_dev_s *priv = &g_lcddev;
191:   int ret = OK;
192: 
193:   nxsem_wait(&priv->sem);
194: 
195:   switch (cmd) {
196:   case LCDIOC_POWERON:
197:     pr_debug("LCD power on\n");
198:     aicfb_ioctl(AICFB_POWERON, NULL);
199:     break;
200: 
201:   case LCDIOC_POWEROFF:
202:     pr_debug("LCD power off\n");
203:     aicfb_ioctl(AICFB_POWEROFF, NULL);
204:     break;
205: 
206:   case LCDIOC_GETINFO: {
207:     struct lcd_info_s *info = (struct lcd_info_s *)arg;
208:     if (priv->fbi) {
209:       info->width = priv->fbi->width;
210:       info->height = priv->fbi->height;
211:       info->bpp = priv->fbi->bits_per_pixel;
212:       info->fmt = FB_FMT_RGB32;
213:     }
214:     break;
215:   }
216: 
217:   case LCDIOC_SETBRIGHTNESS:
218:     pr_debug("LCD set brightness: %lu\n", arg);
219:     break;
220: 
221:   default:
222:     ret = -ENOTTY;
223:     break;
224:   }
225: 
226:   nxsem_post(&priv->sem);
227:   return ret;
228: }
229: 
230: static const struct file_operations g_lcdops = {
231:     lcd_open,  /* open */
232:     lcd_close, /* close */
233:     lcd_read,  /* read */
234:     lcd_write, /* write */
235:     NULL,      /* seek */
236:     lcd_ioctl, /* ioctl */
237:     NULL       /* poll */
238: };
239: 
240: FAR struct lcd_dev_s *aic_lcd_getdev(void) { return &g_lcddev.dev; }
241: 
242: int lcd_register_device(void) {
243:   struct aic_lcd_dev_s *priv = &g_lcddev;
244:   int ret;
245: 
246:   aic_lcd_initdev(priv);
247: 
248:   if (!priv->fbi) {
249:     pr_err("Failed to initialize LCD device\n");
250:     return -EINVAL;
251:   }
252: 
253:   ret = register_driver("/dev/lcd0", &g_lcdops, 0666, priv);
254:   if (ret < 0) {
255:     pr_err("Failed to register LCD device: %d\n", ret);
256:     nxsem_destroy(&priv->sem);
257:     return ret;
258:   }
259: 
260:   return OK;
261: }
262: 
263: void lcd_unregister_device(void) {
264:   struct aic_lcd_dev_s *priv = &g_lcddev;
265: 
266:   unregister_driver("/dev/lcd0");
267:   nxsem_destroy(&priv->sem);
268: }

10: bool is_ui_rect_win_overlap(struct aic_de_comp *comp, u32 layer_id, u32 rect_id,
11:                             u32 x, u32 y, u32 w, u32 h) {
12:   int i;
13:   u32 index;
14:   u32 cur_x, cur_y;
15:   u32 cur_w, cur_h;
16: 
17:   index = (layer_id << RECT_NUM_SHIFT);
18: 
19:   for (i = 0; i < MAX_RECT_NUM; i++) {
20:     if (rect_id == i) {
21:       index++;
22:       continue;
23:     }
24: 
25:     if (comp->layers[index].enable) {
26:       if (comp->layers[index].buf.crop_en) {
27:         cur_w = comp->layers[index].buf.crop.width;
28:         cur_h = comp->layers[index].buf.crop.height;
29:       } else {
30:         cur_w = comp->layers[index].buf.size.width;
31:         cur_h = comp->layers[index].buf.size.height;
32:       }
33:       cur_x = comp->layers[index].pos.x;
34:       cur_y = comp->layers[index].pos.y;
35: 
36:       if ((min(y + h, cur_y + cur_h) > max(y, cur_y)) &&
37:           (min(x + w, cur_x + cur_w) > max(x, cur_x))) {
38:         return true;
39:       }
40:     }
41:     index++;
42:   }
43:   return false;
44: }

46: bool is_valid_ui_rect_size(struct aic_de_comp *comp,
47:                            struct aicfb_layer_data *layer_data) {
48:   u32 src_width;
49:   u32 src_height;
50:   u32 x_offset;
51:   u32 y_offset;
52:   u32 active_w;
53:   u32 active_h;
54: 
55:   u32 w;
56:   u32 h;
57: 
58:   src_width = layer_data->buf.size.width;
59:   src_height = layer_data->buf.size.height;
60:   x_offset = layer_data->pos.x;
61:   y_offset = layer_data->pos.y;
62:   active_w = comp->timing->hactive;
63:   active_h = comp->timing->vactive;
64: 
65:   if (x_offset >= active_w || y_offset >= active_h) {
66:     pr_err("ui layer x or y offset is invalid\n");
67:     return false;
68:   }
69: 
70:   if (layer_data->buf.crop_en) {
71:     u32 crop_x = layer_data->buf.crop.x;
72:     u32 crop_y = layer_data->buf.crop.y;
73: 
74:     if (crop_x >= src_width || crop_y >= src_height) {
75:       pr_err("ui layer crop is invalid\n");
76:       return false;
77:     }
78: 
79:     if ((crop_x + layer_data->buf.crop.width) > src_width)
80:       layer_data->buf.crop.width = src_width - crop_x;
81: 
82:     if ((crop_y + layer_data->buf.crop.height) > src_height)
83:       layer_data->buf.crop.height = src_height - crop_y;
84: 
85:     if ((x_offset + layer_data->buf.crop.width) > active_w)
86:       layer_data->buf.crop.width = active_w - x_offset;
87: 
88:     if ((y_offset + layer_data->buf.crop.height) > active_h)
89:       layer_data->buf.crop.height = active_h - y_offset;
90: 
91:     w = layer_data->buf.crop.width;
92:     h = layer_data->buf.crop.height;
93:   } else {
94:     if ((x_offset + src_width) > active_w)
95:       layer_data->buf.size.width = active_w - x_offset;
96: 
97:     if ((y_offset + src_height) > active_h)
98:       layer_data->buf.size.height = active_h - y_offset;
99: 
100:     w = layer_data->buf.size.width;
101:     h = layer_data->buf.size.height;
102:   }
103: 
104:   /* check overlap  */
105:   if (is_ui_rect_win_overlap(comp, layer_data->layer_id, layer_data->rect_id,
106:                              x_offset, y_offset, w, h)) {
107:     pr_err("ui rect is overlap\n");
108:     return false;
109:   }
110:   return true;
111: }

135: int config_ui_layer_rect(struct aic_de_comp *comp,
136:                          struct aicfb_layer_data *layer_data) {
137:   enum mpp_pixel_format format = layer_data->buf.format;
138:   u32 in_w = (u32)layer_data->buf.size.width;
139:   u32 in_h = (u32)layer_data->buf.size.height;
140: 
141:   u32 stride0 = layer_data->buf.stride[0];
142:   u32 addr0 = layer_data->buf.phy_addr[0];
143:   u32 x_offset = layer_data->pos.x;
144:   u32 y_offset = layer_data->pos.y;
145:   u32 crop_en = layer_data->buf.crop_en;
146:   u32 crop_x = layer_data->buf.crop.x;
147:   u32 crop_y = layer_data->buf.crop.y;
148:   u32 crop_w = layer_data->buf.crop.width;
149:   u32 crop_h = layer_data->buf.crop.height;
150: 
151:   switch (format) {
152:   case MPP_FMT_ARGB_8888:
153:   case MPP_FMT_ABGR_8888:
154:   case MPP_FMT_RGBA_8888:
155:   case MPP_FMT_BGRA_8888:
156:   case MPP_FMT_XRGB_8888:
157:   case MPP_FMT_XBGR_8888:
158:   case MPP_FMT_RGBX_8888:
159:   case MPP_FMT_BGRX_8888:
160:     if (crop_en) {
161:       addr0 += crop_x * 4 + crop_y * stride0;
162:       in_w = crop_w;
163:       in_h = crop_h;
164:     }
165:     break;
166:   case MPP_FMT_RGB_888:
167:   case MPP_FMT_BGR_888:
168:     if (crop_en) {
169:       addr0 += crop_x * 3 + crop_y * stride0;
170:       in_w = crop_w;
171:       in_h = crop_h;
172:     }
173:     break;
174:   case MPP_FMT_ARGB_1555:
175:   case MPP_FMT_ABGR_1555:
176:   case MPP_FMT_RGBA_5551:
177:   case MPP_FMT_BGRA_5551:
178:   case MPP_FMT_RGB_565:
179:   case MPP_FMT_BGR_565:
180:   case MPP_FMT_ARGB_4444:
181:   case MPP_FMT_ABGR_4444:
182:   case MPP_FMT_RGBA_4444:
183:   case MPP_FMT_BGRA_4444:
184:     if (crop_en) {
185:       addr0 += crop_x * 2 + crop_y * stride0;
186:       in_w = crop_w;
187:       in_h = crop_h;
188:     }
189:     break;
190:   default:
191:     pr_err("invalid ui layer format: %d\n", format);
192: 
193:     return -EINVAL;
194:   }
195: 
196:   if (is_all_rect_win_disabled(comp, layer_data->layer_id)) {
197:     de_set_ui_layer_format(comp->regs, format);
198:     de_ui_layer_enable(comp->regs, 1);
199:   }
200: 
201: #ifdef AIC_SCREEN_CROP
202:   x_offset += AIC_SCREEN_CROP_POS_X;
203:   y_offset += AIC_SCREEN_CROP_POS_Y;
204: #endif
205: 
206:   de_ui_layer_set_rect(comp->regs, in_w, in_h, x_offset, y_offset, stride0,
207:                        addr0, layer_data->rect_id);
208:   de_ui_layer_rect_enable(comp->regs, layer_data->rect_id, 1);
209: 
210:   return 0;
211: }

123: /****************************************************************************
124:  * Public Functions
125:  ****************************************************************************/
126: 
127: /****************************************************************************
128:  * Name: up_irqinitialize
129:  *
130:  * Description:
131:  *   Initialize the interrupt subsystem
132:  *
133:  ****************************************************************************/
134: 
135: void up_irqinitialize(void)
136: {
137:   int i;
138:   uint32_t mxstatus;
139:   uint32_t mexstatus;
140: 
141:   /* Match the proven D12x NuttX port before installing the NuttX trap
142:    * entry.  In particular, undo the automatic E907 stack operations left
143:    * enabled by the Luban bootloader; otherwise an interrupt can restore a
144:    * hardware-modified SP into a NuttX software context.
145:    */
146: 
147:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrci mstatus, 0x8");
148:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrw mie, zero");
149:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrr %0, 0x7c0" : "=r"(mxstatus));
150:   mxstatus |= D13X_MXSTATUS_MM | D13X_MXSTATUS_ISAEE;
151:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrw 0x7c0, %0" :: "r"(mxstatus));
152: 
153:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrr %0, 0x7e1" : "=r"(mexstatus));
154:   mexstatus &= ~(D13X_MEXSTATUS_SPUSHEN | D13X_MEXSTATUS_SPSWAPEN);
155:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrw 0x7e1, %0" :: "r"(mexstatus));
156: 
157:   /* Configure the common CLIC trap entry and the E907 vector-table CSR. */
158: 
159:   /* Every CLIC source below uses ATTR.SHV=0 and therefore enters through
160:    * one common NuttX handler.  E907 CLIC mode 2 is the non-vectored mode;
161:    * mode 3 is reserved for the Luban hardware-vector entry model and keeps
162:    * using its bootloader stack state.
163:    */
164: 
165:   uint32_t mtvec = (uint32_t)__trap_vec | 0x2;
166:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrw mtvec, %0" :: "r"(mtvec));
167: 
168:   /* mtvt is CSR 0x307.  CSR 0x7c0 is T-Head MXSTATUS. */
169: 
170:   uint32_t mtvt = (uint32_t)__trap_vec;
171:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrw 0x307, %0" :: "r"(mtvt));
172: 
173:   riscv_exception_attach();
174: 
175:   /* 初始化 CLIC 中断控制器 (来源: luban-lite system.c SystemInit) */
176: 
177:   /* 读取 CLIC 配置信息 */
178: 
179:   volatile uint32_t *cliccfg = (volatile uint32_t *)D13X_CLIC_CFG;
180:   volatile uint32_t *clicinfo = (volatile uint32_t *)D13X_CLIC_INFO;
181: 
182:   uint32_t info = *clicinfo;
183:   uint32_t nlbits = (info >> 21) & 0xF;
184: 
185:   *cliccfg = (nlbits << 1) & 0x1E;
186: 
187:   /* Never inherit a bootloader interrupt threshold.  In CLIC mode an
188:    * enabled source is still masked when its level does not exceed this
189:    * threshold.
190:    */
191: 
192:   *(volatile uint32_t *)D13X_CLIC_MINTTHRESH = 0;
193: 
194:   /* 初始化所有中断: 清除 pending, 使能向量中断 */
195: 
196:   for (i = 0; i < MAX_IRQn; i++)
197:     {
198:       d13x_clic_disable_irq(i);
199:       d13x_clic_clear_pending(i);
200:       /* NuttX provides one common __trap_vec entry, not a hardware vector
201:        * table.  Keep SHV clear so all IRQs use the common entry.
202:        */
203: 
204:       d13x_clic_set_attr(i, 0);
205:     }
206: 
207:   /* tspend 使用正向中断 (来源: luban-lite system.c) */
208: 
209:   d13x_clic_set_attr(Machine_Software_IRQn, 0x2);
210: 
211:   /* 使能全局中断 */
212: 
213:   up_irq_enable();
214: }
215: 
216: /****************************************************************************
217:  * Name: up_enable_irq
218:  *
219:  * Description:
220:  *   Enable the interrupt specified by 'irq'
221:  *
222:  ****************************************************************************/
223: 
224: void up_enable_irq(int irq)
225: {
226:   int raw_irq = irq - RISCV_IRQ_ASYNC;
227: 
228:   if ((unsigned int)raw_irq < MAX_IRQn)
229:     {
230:       if (irq == RISCV_IRQ_MTIMER)
231:         {
232:           /* CLICCFG assigns all implemented CTL bits to interrupt level.
233:            * Give CORET a nonzero, unambiguously eligible level instead of
234:            * relying on the value left by tinySPL.
235:            */
236: 
237:           d13x_clic_set_control(raw_irq, UINT8_MAX);
238:         }
239: 
240:       d13x_clic_enable_irq(raw_irq);
241: 
242:       /* CORET is exposed as both CLIC source 7 and the architectural
243:        * machine-timer interrupt.  The per-source CLIC enable is necessary
244:        * but not sufficient: mie.MTIE must also be set before the pending
245:        * compare match can enter the CPU.
246:        */
247: 
248:       if (irq == RISCV_IRQ_MTIMER)
249:         {
250:           uint32_t mtie = 1u << 7;
251: 
252:           __asm__ __volatile__("csrs mie, %0" :: "r"(mtie));
253:         }
254:     }
255: }

257: /****************************************************************************
258:  * Name: up_disable_irq

265: void up_disable_irq(int irq)

267:   int raw_irq = irq - RISCV_IRQ_ASYNC;

269:   if ((unsigned int)raw_irq < MAX_IRQn)
270:     {
271:       if (irq == RISCV_IRQ_MTIMER)

274: 
275:           __asm__ __volatile__("csrc mie, %0" :: "r"(mtie));
276:         }

278:       d13x_clic_disable_irq(raw_irq);
279:     }
280: }

10.1.3.1. 影子寄存器 (Shadow Register)
为了实现一组配置同时生效，DE 的大部分寄存器都是对应两个寄存器。
• Preload register：软件可以操作的寄存器，用于存储配置参数。

• CONFIG_UPDATE：设置该标志位为 1，可以将 Preload 寄存器的值同时更新到 Shadow 寄存器。

当 SPI 工作在 Quad I/O 模式下，串行 Flash 设备支持带回环的突发传输 (Burst With Wrap)：
• 发送突发传输配置命令 0x77 或 0xC0，配置三个 dummy 字节。
• 配置 Mode 字节的 bit[6:4] 为相应的突发类型和突发长度。
常用于 XIP 访问模式下，CPU 进行 Cache 操作，可以提高总线的传输效率，提高代码的执行性能。当 CPU 使用 Cache，
并开启预取功能，突发传输类型配置为 WRAP，突发传输长度配置为 32 个字节。
在 XIP 模式下，配置 SPI_BTR.WRAP_EN 位为 1，使能回环模式，控制器在发送第一笔接收命令之前，会自动根据
SPI_BTR 寄存器的配置，自动发送突发传输配置命令。

--

在 RS485-2 线模式中：
• UART-TX 既可以发送数据也可以接收数据。
• UART-RX 在模块内部与 UART-RTS 复用，用于控制 DE 使能发送。
• 当进入 RS485-2 模式，RTS 复用至 UART_RX PIN 脚，TX 和 RX 共用 UART_TX PIN 脚。TX 发送使能时，RX 拉高
进入空闲状态且 RX 接收通路关闭。TX 发送使能关闭后，开启 RX 接收通路。数据收发处理逻辑与常规 RS485 模
式类似。

10.1. Display Engine (DE)
显示引擎 (Display Engine) 主要用来提供显示图层叠加、颜色空间转换、图像缩放、图像后处理等功能， 可以实现多个图

--
www.artinchip.com

10.1.3.1. 影子寄存器 (Shadow Register)
为了实现一组配置同时生效，DE 的大部分寄存器都是对应两个寄存器。
• Preload register：软件可以操作的寄存器，用于存储配置参数。
• Shadow register：软件不可见，由硬件操作，用于控制硬件行为。
• CONFIG_UPDATE：设置该标志位为 1，可以将 Preload 寄存器的值同时更新到 Shadow 寄存器。
除了 CRC 校验、CCM 和 Gamma 矫正、QoS、Timing 相关寄存器和 DE 配置更新寄存器之外， 其它的寄存器都有 shadow
register。

常用于 XIP 访问模式下，CPU 进行 Cache 操作，可以提高总线的传输效率，提高代码的执行性能。当 CPU 使用 Cache，

在 XIP 模式下，配置 SPI_BTR.WRAP_EN 位为 1，使能回环模式，控制器在发送第一笔接收命令之前，会自动根据
SPI_BTR 寄存器的配置，自动发送突发传输配置命令。

在 RS485-2 线模式中：
• UART-TX 既可以发送数据也可以接收数据。
• UART-RX 在模块内部与 UART-RTS 复用，用于控制 DE 使能发送。
• 当进入 RS485-2 模式，RTS 复用至 UART_RX PIN 脚，TX 和 RX 共用 UART_TX PIN 脚。TX 发送使能时，RX 拉高
进入空闲状态且 RX 接收通路关闭。TX 发送使能关闭后，开启 RX 接收通路。数据收发处理逻辑与常规 RS485 模
式类似。
